clusters.title: Ïawphñiaw / Phñiaw / Nongrum / Rumnong / Nongneng
clusters.summary_khasi: Mih na ka Phñiaw ha Rymbai/Tongseng bad pur sha Shella, Sohra, bad Sepngi. Ki Nongneng/Nengnong bad Nongrum/Rumnong ki ïalong shikur bad ki Ïawphñiaw.
clusters.summary_english: Originates from Ka Phñiaw. Nongrum, Rumnong, Nongneng, Nengnong, and Nongrem share the same bloodline with Ïawphñiaw.
